# Status

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_status.py from docs/status.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

What actually works, reviewed 2026-10-26. Edit `docs/status.yaml` and run `python scripts/gen_status.py`; CI fails if this page is stale. A **works** row must cite evidence that exists in the repo.

Statuses: **works** (implemented end to end), **partial** (known gaps or untested), **broken** (implemented but cannot succeed), **stub** (placeholder), **absent**.

| Reminders and phase transitions | partial | Deadlines and leased delivery persist in Postgres; restart and send/ack behavior tested. | Audio acquisition | works | Opt-in `python -m sidetrack.audio` (ADR 0007): YouTube Music full tracks and Deezer previews, content-addressed storage, AcoustID verification, manifest, verify and prune. | Embedding models (any) | partial | MuQ, MuQ-MuLan, MERT-v1-95M and CLAP run on the owner's RTX 5070 (gpu-marked tests and a 10-asset smoke run, 2026-10-26). Quality is unjudged; the GTX 1070 Ti is unmeasured | `services/audio-lab/tests/test_adapters_gpu.py`, `docs/AUDIO-BENCHMARK.md` |
